When the first dwords of both endpoints are equal the output is hardcoded to (10, 10); otherwise the first output dword is a1 and the second is a rounded interpolation between a2[1] and a3[1] weighted by (a3[0] - a1) over (a3[0] - a2[0]), using CRTFtol to convert the float result to int. Called by sub_475A90.

local_names.v5: interpolated integer result for the second output dword
